limits: Offline complete-source projection and PCM output; no progressive UI/controller gapless adapter yet
Chunk boundaries are a model over decoded PCM; no writer pause/update test of a gapless player path
FFmpeg decoder-delay 529 is explicit to the tested implementations, not a universal MP3 constant
Raw encoder delay/padding has no LAME tag CRC validation yet
Classic DirectShow output needs an independently verified adapter; it is not covered by this libmpv test
VBRI is excluded because it has no proven LAME encoder delay/padding contract
